toolsPreview.name: html_to_pdf_wk
toolsPreview.description: Convert HTML to PDF using the wkhtmltopdf rendering engine. Supports JavaScript execution and screen-capture style rendering. Good for simple documents, web page snapshots, layouts that rely on JavaScript, and **fillable PDF forms** (pass 'enable-forms' as an extra argument). Available on all PdfBroker.io plans including the free tier. Does NOT support PDF/A or PDF/UA compliance — use html_to_pdf for compliant documents. Defaults reflect EU-first usage: A4 paper, Portrait orientation.

toolsPreview.name: html_to_pdf
toolsPreview.description: Convert HTML and CSS to a PDF document using the WeasyPrint rendering engine. Supports PDF/A-1b, PDF/A-3b, and PDF/UA compliance standards. Best for professional documents: invoices, reports, certificates, contracts, and accessible documents. Send a complete HTML document including <html>, <head> with <style>, and <body> tags. Returns a temporary download URL for the generated PDF (valid for 30 minutes). Requires a paid PdfBroker.io plan (Starter or above). Defaults reflect EU-first usage: A4 paper, Portrait orientation.
